column13: Howard Jones' suffocating defense did not concede a single point across 10 games, anchored by end John Kilpatrick and fullback Ted Coy. The season reached its climax in the Championship Decider, where Howard Jones's Yale squad secured national championship honors over Percy Haughton's Harvard.
